name: threads-bg
description: A lead chat creates real Claude Code background sessions (claude --bg) on chosen models, watches them live and steers them. Port of Prompt Advisers' threads 0.5.3 from tmux to claude --bg; runs on Windows.

author.name: Prompt Advisers (threads 0.5.3); Valerii Yerokhin, TheDrobot (claude --bg port)

defaultPermissionMode.title: Default permission mode
defaultPermissionMode.description: Permission mode for new session threads and plan phases unless one sets its own. lead = this chat's own mode (messages between the two are never held). /threads mode overrides this for the install.

idleCloseMinutes.title: Close idle threads after (minutes)
idleCloseMinutes.description: Finished session threads of this chat that stay idle this long are closed (transcript kept). Working, waiting and pinned threads are never closed. 0 turns it off.
